Job Description Summary 
Le/la PMCC Senior est un(e) expert(e) en gestion contractuelle, financière et des achats dans le domaine de la Construction et Mise en service (C&C). Fort(e) d'une solide expérience sur des projets industriels et énergétiques complexes, il/elle agit comme mentor et référent métier auprès des PMCC, en apportant des conseils stratégiques, en partageant les meilleures pratiques et en favorisant leur développement professionnel. Ce rôle ne comporte aucune responsabilité hiérarchique ou opérationnelle directe sur les autres PMCC, qui conservent l'entière responsabilité de leurs projets et décisions.
The Senior PMCC is an experienced professional in contractual, financial, and procurement management within Construction & Commissioning (C&C). With extensive experience in complex industrial and energy projects, the Senior PMCC serves as a mentor and subject matter expert, providing strategic guidance, sharing best practices, and supporting the professional development of other PMCCs. This role carries no direct managerial or operational responsibility for other PMCCs, who retain full accountability for their projects and decisions. 
 Job Description 
 Responsabilités principales
 1. Contrat et réclamations
 Agir comme expert de référence en gestion contractuelle, notamment sur les périmètres, exclusions, avenants et réclamations.
 Conseiller les PMCC sur les écarts contractuels et les stratégies de préparation des réclamations client.
 Partager les meilleures pratiques en matière de collecte de preuves, d'imputation des coûts et de documentation contractuelle.
 Apporter un soutien consultatif sur les situations contractuelles complexes, en collaboration avec les Directeurs de Projet et les Contract Managers.
 2. Budget et contrôle des coûts
 Fournir une expertise et des conseils sur le contrôle des budgets chantier, les prévisions financières et la distribution des coûts.
 Accompagner les PMCC dans l'identification des risques financiers, des écarts budgétaires et des mesures d'atténuation.
 Partager les meilleures pratiques pour la préparation des revues mensuelles (MPR/PMR).
 Contribuer à l'amélioration des méthodes et outils de suivi budgétaire.
 3. Achats et sous-traitants
 Conseiller les PMCC sur les stratégies d'achat, les appels d'offres (RFQ), les négociations et la gestion des contrats de sous-traitance.
 Partager son expertise sur l'élaboration des SoW, les bons de commande (PO), la facturation et les processus VBB.
 Promouvoir l'alignement contractuel des sous-traitants avec les priorités SQDC de GEV, y compris les exigences EHS.
 Accompagner les PMCC dans la résolution de problématiques complexes liées aux achats et aux sous-traitants.
 4. Avant l'ouverture du site et mobilisation
 Fournir des conseils sur la préparation des Gate Reviews et les processus de mobilisation conformément aux standards GEV.
 Partager les meilleures pratiques concernant les budgets de mobilisation, la planification et la préparation des chantiers.
 Apporter une expertise sur les stratégies logistiques, les installations de chantier et les besoins en outillage (achat ou location).
 Conseiller sur la coordination des équipes, du TFA et des livrables Méthodes avant la mobilisation.
 5. Pendant l'exécution du chantier
 Agir comme mentor et conseiller auprès des PMCC sur les enjeux rencontrés pendant l'exécution des chantiers.
 Fournir des recommandations sur la gestion des risques, des écarts budgétaires et des problématiques contractuelles.
 Promouvoir les meilleures pratiques en matière de sécurité, qualité, livraison et coûts.
 Faciliter le partage d'expérience sur la coordination entre les équipes de chantier, Engineering et Supply Chain.
 Effectuer des visites de chantier ponctuelles afin de partager son expertise et de soutenir les équipes, au besoin.
 6. Mise en service
 Conseiller les PMCC sur la préparation et la coordination des activités de mise en service.
 Partager les meilleures pratiques concernant la planification, le contrôle budgétaire et les exigences documentaires.
 Apporter son expertise sur les interfaces entre construction et mise en service.
 7. SSE et qualité
 Promouvoir une forte culture SSE (santé, sécurité et environnment) et qualité à travers le mentorat et le partage des meilleures pratiques.
 Conseiller sur l'intégration des exigences EHS dans les SoW et les contrats de sous-traitance.
 Encourager l'identification proactive des risques et l'application des standards de sécurité GEV.
 8. Gouvernance et amélioration continue
 Agir comme référent métier et soutenir le développement des compétences des PMCC.
 Contribuer à l'amélioration des processus, outils et méthodes de gestion de projet C&C.
 Faciliter le partage des Lessons Learned après les phases majeures des projets (Démontage, Montage, Mise en service).
 Conseiller les Directeurs de Projet et les PMCC sur les situations complexes nécessitant une expertise senior.
 Promouvoir l'utilisation des outils numériques, de l'intelligence artificielle et des méthodologies avancées de gestion de projet.
 Droits de décision
 Le/la PMCC Senior agit à titre de mentor et de conseiller stratégique auprès des PMCC, en apportant son expertise sur les budgets, les coûts, les enjeux contractuels, les achats et la gestion des sous-traitants. Il/elle contribue aux Gate Reviews et aux Lessons Learned en formulant des recommandations et en partageant les meilleures pratiques. Ce rôle ne comporte aucune autorité hiérarchique, responsabilité décisionnelle ou droit de veto sur les projets des autres PMCC.
 Profil
 Requis
 10 ans et plus d'expérience en gestion de projets de construction et de mise en service, idéalement dans les secteurs industriel ou énergétique.
 Expertise approfondie en gestion contractuelle, contrôle des coûts, réclamations, avenants et gestion des sous-traitants (RFQ, SoW, facturation).
 Expérience démontrée sur des projets complexes de construction ou de mise en service.
 Forte culture EHS et sens aigu de la qualité.
 Diplôme d'ingénieur ou expérience terrain équivalente.
 Excellente communication écrite et orale en français et en anglais.
 Leadership, rigueur et capacité à conseiller, influencer et accompagner sans autorité hiérarchique.
 Aptitude démontrée au mentorat, au transfert de connaissances et au développement des compétences.
 Poste basé à Brossard avec disponibilité pour voyager sur les chantiers au Québec et à travers le Canada, selon les besoins.
 Atouts importants
 Solide expérience en hydroélectricité (turbines, alternateurs, balance of plant mécanique et électrique).
 Maîtrise de P6/MSP, des outils IA et de la méthode LPS (Last Planner System).
 Expérience dans des environnements de projets complexes et internationaux.
 Contribution démontrée à l'amélioration continue et à la standardisation des pratiques de gestion de projet.
 Primary Responsibilities
 1. Contract and claims
 Act as a subject matter expert in contract management, including scope, exclusions, change orders, and claims.
 Advise PMCCs on contractual deviations and customer claim preparation strategies.
 Share best practices for evidence collection, cost allocation, and contractual documentation.
 Provide advisory support on complex contractual matters in collaboration with Project Directors and Contract Managers.
 2. Budget and cost control
 Provide expertise and guidance on site budget management, financial forecasting, and cost distribution.
 Mentor PMCCs in identifying financial risks, budget deviations, and mitigation measures.
 Share best practices for preparing monthly project reviews (MPR/PMR).
 Contribute to improving budget monitoring methods and tools.
 3. Procurement and subcontractors
 Advise PMCCs on procurement strategies, RFQs, negotiations, and subcontractor contract management.
 Share expertise in developing SoWs, purchase orders (PO), invoicing, and VBB processes.
 Promote alignment of subcontractors with GEV's SQDC priorities, including EHS requirements.
 Support PMCCs in addressing complex procurement and subcontractor challenges.
 4. Pre-site opening and mobilization
 Provide guidance on Gate Reviews and mobilization processes in accordance with GEV standards.
 Share best practices for mobilization budgets, planning, and site readiness.
 Offer expertise on site logistics, facilities, and tooling strategies (buy vs. rent).
 Advise on coordination between site teams, TFA, and Methods deliverables prior to mobilization.
 5. During site execution
 Act as a mentor and advisor to PMCCs on challenges encountered during site execution.
 Provide recommendations on risk management, budget deviations, and contractual issues.
 Promote best practices in safety, quality, delivery, and cost management.
 Facilitate knowledge sharing on coordination between site teams, Engineering, and Supply Chain.
 Conduct occasional site visits to share expertise and support teams when needed.
 6. Commissioning
 Advise PMCCs on commissioning preparation and coordination.
 Share best practices for commissioning planning, budget control, and documentation requirements.
 Provide expertise on interfaces between construction and commissioning activities.
 7. EHS and quality
 Promote a strong EHS and quality culture through mentorship and knowledge sharing.
 Advise on integrating EHS requirements into SoWs and subcontractor agreements.
 Encourage proactive risk identification and adherence to GEV safety standards.
 8. Governance and continuous improvement
 Act as a subject matter expert and support the professional development of PMCCs.
 Contribute to improving C&C project management processes, tools, and methodologies.
 Facilitate Lessons Learned sharing following major project phases (Disassembly, Erection, Commissioning).
 Advise Project Directors and PMCCs on complex situations requiring senior-level expertise.
 Promote the adoption of digital tools, artificial intelligence, and advanced project management methodologies.
 Decision Rights
 The Senior PMCC acts as a mentor and strategic advisor to PMCCs, providing expertise in budget management, cost control, contractual matters, procurement, and subcontractor management. The role contributes to Gate Reviews and Lessons Learned by offering recommendations and sharing best practices. This position does not carry direct managerial authority, decision-making responsibility, or veto rights over projects managed by other PMCCs.
 Profile
 Required
 10+ years of experience in construction and commissioning project management, preferably in industrial or energy projects.
 Extensive expertise in contract management, cost control, claims, change orders, and subcontractor management (RFQ, SoW, invoicing).
 Demonstrated experience in complex construction or commissioning projects.
 Strong EHS culture and attention to quality.
 Engineering degree or equivalent field experience.
 Excellent written and spoken English and French.
 Leadership, rigor, and the ability to advise, influence, and mentor without direct managerial authority.
 Demonstrated ability to mentor professionals, transfer knowledge, and develop capabilities.
 Base office in Brossard with availability to travel to project sites across Québec and Canada as needed.
 Strong assets
 Strong hydropower background (turbines, generators, mechanical and electrical balance of plant).
 Experience with P6/MSP, AI tools, and LPS (Last Planner System).
 Experience in complex and international project environments.
 Demonstrated contributions to continuous improvement and standardization of project management practices.
 Additional Information 
 Relocation Assistance Provided: No

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.

ABOUT YOUR ROLE

This is an exciting opportunity to join a fast paced start-up environment to help build out Juniper Square’s Fund Administration service offering. Juniper Square is on a mission to transform the Fund Administration offering to Private Markets. We are more than a Fund Administrator, we are a Modern Fund Administrator.  As a Fund Accountant you will partner with the customer, other members of the fund accounting team, and Investor Services and Fund Administration Onboarding teams to deliver  fund accounting and reporting services to Juniper Square’s Private Market customers in the Real Estate, Private Equity, and Venture Capital space. You will have a significant opportunity to shape the trajectory of our service offering and in so doing help to deliver a best-in-class experience to our customers. We are a team of values based self-starters with a curious mindset and the motivation to use technology to our advantage so that we are continually iterating and improving on the status quo. This is an opportunity to couple prior education and experience and to learn from some of the best talent in Private Markets.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Contribute to decision making regarding team operational policies and procedures

 - Help to define fund administration workflows, applying best practices and process efficiencies

 - Assist in training of team members on processes and monitoring client deliverables 

 - Interface directly with clients to deliver an outstanding client experience

 - Perform accounting, analytical, & financial reporting duties; ensure client and investor reporting is prepared and completed timely and accurately

 - Prepare waterfall calculations, capital calls and distributions in accordance with clients’ Limited Partnership Agreements as applicable

 - Prepare asset- and fund-level performance metrics (IRRs, TVPI, etc.)

 - Assist in preparing, compiling, and verifying external client and regulatory reporting

 - Prepare financial information for stockholders/investor reports

 - Support annual audits, including preparation of the initial draft of the annual audit report and related schedules 

QUALIFICATIONS

 - 1+ years of fund accounting experience in fund administration and/or in-house with exposure to Private Equity (open-ended and/or close-ended), Private Debt and/or Real Estate funds

 - Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or related field required

 - Investran experience preferred

 - Fundamental knowledge of accounting rules and procedures for private investment funds, including experience with fund-level accounting and reporting 

 - Exposure to waterfall, performance metrics (IRRs), distributions and capital calls calculations

 - Passion for technology and a desire to use technology to improve business operations

 - Possess strong analytical skills required in reviewing, researching and resolving issues surrounding accounting and financial matters

 - Excellent interpersonal and client service skills, verbal and written communication

COMPENSATION 

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this role is $65,000 - $80,000. The Canadian base salary range for this role is $70,000 - $85,000. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable. We are actively hiring for this role in Canada, and offer competitive local pay and benefits. Your recruiter can provide further details.

Benefits include:

 - Life insurance and disability coverage

 - Mental wellness coverage

 - Fertility and growing family support

 - 401k retirement savings plan

 - Healthcare FSA and commuter benefits programs

 - Annual professional development stipend

 Il s’agit d’un poste de collaborateur(-trice) individuel(le) senior de haut niveau pour un(e) artiste expérimenté(e) capable d’œuvrer tant au niveau stratégique qu’opérationnel. Vous effectuerez un travail de qualité exemplaire, établirez des normes de production pratiques, résoudrez des problèmes artistiques et techniques complexes, et guiderez les équipes en environnements travaillant sur différents projets, moteurs, styles et studios partenaires.
 Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les directeurs artistiques, les gestionnaires de projet, les équipes d’art technique, de production, de conception et d’ingénierie, les clients et les studios partenaires pour traduire des objectifs créatifs en stratégies claires et réalisables pour l’art des environnements.
 Ce rôle exige une grande capacité de leadership, un esprit critique, une aptitude à communiquer clairement, et la capacité à influencer les équipes par l’expertise, l’exemple et la collaboration.
 Définition du succès
 Au cours de vos 90 premiers jours de travail…
 vous développerez une solide compréhension des projets, des clients, de la structure de production et des capacités en matière d’art des environnements de GameSim;
 vous bâtirez une relation de confiance avec les artistes, les responsables de projet, les clients et les studios partenaires grâce à une communication claire et à une prise de décision fiable;
 vous créerez ou guiderez le développement d’un travail de qualité exemplaire qui établit un niveau visuel et technique clair;
 vous identifierez un défi artistique, technique ou lié aux flux des travaux significatif, et contribuerez à la mise en œuvre d’une amélioration concrète;
 vous fournirez des commentaires et du mentorat qui améliorent la qualité, la cohérence et l’efficacité de l’équipe des environnements.
 Responsabilités
 Exécution et leadership artistique
 Créer des environnements en temps réel de haute qualité, de l’architecture, des kits modulaires, des éléments vedettes, des matériaux, des terrains, de la végétation et du contenu de construction de monde.
 Produire des éléments et des scènes de référence qui communiquent les attentes en matière de composition, d’échelle, de hiérarchie visuelle, de qualité des matériaux, de narration environnementale et de peaufinage final.
 Traduire la direction artistique, l’art conceptuel, les documents de référence, les exigences de conception, les commentaires des clients en objectifs de production clairs.
 Établir des stratégies d’art des environnements pour la construction modulaire, la réutilisation des éléments, les planches de textures, les systèmes de matériaux, le terrain, la végétation, l’agencement et la création des mondes.
 Maintenir une contribution pratique significative lors de l’établissement des normes de qualité, de la validation des flux des travaux, de la résolution de problèmes complexes ou du soutien aux livrables essentiels.
 Évaluer objectivement les créations des environnements et fournir des commentaires précis et exploitables par le biais de revues, de corrections graphiques, de maquettes, de planches de référence, de documentation ou d’exemples intégrés au moteur.
 Développement de la production et des pipelines
 Collaborer avec la direction artistique, la production et l’équipe d’art technique pour définir des flux des travaux des environnements qui équilibrent la qualité visuelle, le champ d’application, le calendrier et les exigences techniques.
 Identifier tôt dans le processus les risques artistiques, techniques et de production, et recommander des solutions pratiques.
 Aider les équipes à décomposer des instructions générales ou incomplètes en tâches, étapes, priorités et critères d’acceptation compréhensibles.
 Améliorer les pipelines de création des environnements artistiques grâce à des flux des travaux réutilisables, des modèles, de la documentation, des exemples d’éléments et des normes de production.
 Soutenir la planification et l’estimation en évaluant la complexité des actifs, les dépendances, les besoins en personnel et les risques de production.
 Résoudre les problèmes complexes liés à la construction d’éléments, aux matériaux, à la création des mondes, à l’optimisation, à la mise en œuvre du moteur ou à l’intégration du contenu.
 Aider à s’assurer que les environnements répondent aux exigences du projet en matière de performances, de mémoire, de flux, d’appels de rendu, de complexité des nuanceurs, de collisions, de niveaux de détail et de limitations de la plateforme.
 Influence de l'équipe et du projet
 Guider les artistes en environnements au sein des équipes internes, des studios partenaires et des groupes de développement externes.
 Encadrer les artistes seniors et les responsables en devenir en matière de jugement artistique, de communication, de planification, de pratiques d’évaluation et de prise de décision.
 Collaborer avec les directeurs artistiques pour maintenir une orientation visuelle cohérente entre les équipes et les livrables.
 Participer aux réunions avec les clients, aux bilans d’étapes, aux évaluations artistiques et aux discussions de planification de projet lorsque la présence d’un représentant senior en art des environnements est requise.
 Communiquer clairement les risques, les compromis, les priorités et les recommandations aux parties prenantes, artistiques ou non.
 Contribuer à l’harmonisation des équipes travaillant dans différents studios, disciplines, cultures et fuseaux horaires.
 Soutenir les prototypes, les tests artistiques, les présentations de projets, les efforts de préproduction et le développement initial du pipeline.
 Contribuer à la croissance continue de la discipline en art des environnements de GameSim grâce au mentorat, au soutien au recrutement, aux examens de portefolios, à la documentation et à la planification des capacités.
 Exigences
 Expérience professionnelle approfondie dans le développement de jeux, la production en temps réel ou un domaine connexe.
 Plusieurs titres livrés ou des projets en temps réel professionnels comparables.
 Un portfolio témoignant d’une qualité en art des environnements exceptionnelle et d’un excellent jugement en matière de production.
 Maîtrise parfaite de la composition, de l’échelle, des proportions, de la hiérarchie visuelle, du langage des formes, de la définition des matériaux, de la réponse à la lumière, de la narration environnementale et de la cohérence des scènes.
 Expérience avancée dans la création d’environnements modulaires, d’architecture, d’accessoires, de terrains, de matériaux et de systèmes de ressources réutilisables.
 Solide compréhension de la modélisation, des UV, du « baking », de la densité de texels, des planches de textures, des matériaux raccordables, des éléments d’habillage, du mélange par vertex et des flux des travaux de matériaux en temps réel.
 Expérience professionnelle pour développer des environnements dans Unreal Engine ou un autre moteur de jeu en temps réel moderne.
 Solide compréhension de l’optimisation des environnements, incluant des niveaux de détail, de la mémoire, de la diffusion continue, des appels de rendu, des collisions, de la complexité des nuanceurs et des contraintes des plateformes.
 Expérience dans l’établissement des références visuelles, de pipelines d’environnement, de normes de ressources ou de flux de production.
 Capacité démontrée à résoudre des problèmes artistiques, techniques et de production complexes avec une supervision limitée.
 Expérience dans l’encadrement d’artistes seniors, de chefs d’équipe, d’équipes distribuées, de partenaires externes ou de fournisseurs.
 Capacité à fournir des commentaires clair, constructifs et exploitable en matière d’art.
 Solide compréhension d’équilibre entre la qualité, le champ d’application, le calendrier, les exigences techniques et les ressources disponibles.
 Excellentes compétences en présentation et en communication écrite, orale et interpersonnelle.
 Expérience de collaboration avec les équipes de direction artistique, de production, d’art technique, de conception, d’ingénierie, d’éclairage, d’effets visuels et d’autres disciplines de développement.
 Capacité à s’adapter à différents projets, styles visuels, moteurs, pipelines et attentes de la part des clients.
 Aisance à participer aux discussions avec les clients et à représenter les décisions relatives à l’art des environnements de manière professionnelle.
 Expérience technique et connaissance des outils
 Les candidats doivent posséder une expérience avancée dans l’utilisation d’une suite d’outils professionnels d’art en environnements. Ceci peut inclure :
 Maya, Blender, 3ds Max, ou un logiciel de création de contenu 3D comparable
 ZBrush ou une application de sculpture équivalente
 Substance 3D Painter et Substance 3D Designer
 Photoshop ou tout autre logiciel de retouche d’images équivalent
 Unreal Engine 5 ou un autre moteur de jeu en temps réel moderne
 Perforce ou un autre système de gestion du code source en production
 Jira, Confluence, Miro ou tout autre outil similaire de planification et de documentation
 Il n’est pas nécessaire de maîtriser toutes les applications énumérées. Nous recherchons avant tout des candidat(e)s qui font preuve de solides connaissances de base, d’adaptabilité et qui sont capables de choisir les bons outils pour résoudre les problèmes de production.
 Compétences souhaitées
 Expérience professionnelle dans les domaines du co-développement, de l’externalisation, de la consultation ou de la production de jeux vidéo en sous-traitance.
 Expérience de contribution à la conception d’un jeu AAA pour PC ou console.
 Expérience de travail sur des pipelines visuels tant réalistes que stylisés.
 Expérience dans le soutien de différents projets ou équipes au niveau du studio ou d’une discipline
 Expérience dans la gestion d’un niveau, d’un biome, d’une région du monde ou d’une ressource d’environnement majeure, de la planification initiale à la livraison finale.
 Expérience des systèmes Unreal Engine tels que World Partition, Nanite, la texturation virtuelle, la génération de contenu procédural, les outils de paysage, les fonctions de matériaux, les « Blueprints » ou les outils de profilage.
 Expérience avec Houdini, incluant en modélisation procédurale, en génération de terrain, en dispersion, en construction modulaire ou avec les outils destinés aux artistes.
 Expérience des flux des travaux de végétation, SpeedTree, photogrammétrie, génération procédurale ou production d’environnements organiques.
 Expérience en éclairage et en post-traitement suffisant pour définir des objectifs visuels et diagnostiquer les problèmes de présentation.
 Connaissance de Python, des scripts d’éditeur, de l’automatisation ou du développement des outils d’art technique.
 Expérience dans la contribution au cadrage de projet, aux recommandations en matière de personnel, aux appels d’offres, à l’embauche ou à l’évaluation de portefolios.
 Exigences du portfolio 
 Votre portfolio doit démontrer :
 des environnements temps réel de haute qualité, avec une composition, une échelle, une définition des matériaux, une narration environnementale et une cohérence scénique solides;
 un travail présenté avec un moteur en temps réel commercial, propriétaire ou moderne;
 des explications claires concernant votre contribution individuelle, vos responsabilités, votre flux de travail et vos décisions en matière de production;
 des kits modulaires, des systèmes de ressources réutilisables, des flux des travaux de planche de texture, des bibliothèques de matériaux ou des solutions évolutives de création de mondes;
 une bonne compréhension de l’optimisation, de la maintenabilité, de la réutilisation des ressources et des contraintes de production;
 au moins un exemple dans lequel vous avez établi ou influencé de manière significative le niveau de qualité visuelle d’une scène, d’un niveau, d’un biome ou d’un projet;
 la capacité à travailler à partir de concepts artistiques, de références, de maquettes, d’exigences de conception ou de directives créatives incomplètes;
 une adaptabilité à différents projets, genres ou styles visuels.
 Nous encourageons également les candidats à joindre :
 une œuvre qui a été créée par une équipe sous leur direction artistique ou technique;
 des comparaisons avant-après montrant comment ils/elles ont amélioré un environnement, un flux des travaux ou un résultat de production;
 des ressources de référence, guides de style, documents de révision, documentation de pipeline, correction graphiques ou modèles qui ont été créés pour d’autres artistes.
 Veuillez indiquer clairement votre contribution personnelle au travail collectif.
 Comment poser votre candidature
 Un curriculum vitae et un lien vers votre portfolio sont nécessaires.
 Un test artistique pourrait être nécessaire au cours du processus.
 Veuillez indiquer, le cas échéant, les crédits liés à des jeux commercialisés ou toute expérience professionnelle de projets comparables.
 Les candidats pourraient être amenés à participer à un examen de leur portfolio, à un entretien technique, à un entretien portant sur leurs compétences en leadership ou à une évaluation artistique dans le cadre du processus de sélection.
 Ce poste est actuellement ouvert seulement aux candidats et candidates résidant dans les provinces canadiennes suivantes : Ontario, Québec, Alberta ou Colombie-Britannique. 
 Fourchette salariale : entre 120 000 $ et 130 000 $ CA 
 Qu’est-ce que vous y gagnez?
 Occasion de contribuer à une variété de projets, de clients, de genres, de plateformes et de styles visuels
 Capacité à influencer la qualité de l’environnement artistique et les pratiques de production au sein de plusieurs équipes
 Possibilité de collaborer avec des développeurs et des studios expérimentés à travers l’organisation de Keywords Studios
 Possibilités de perfectionnement professionnel et de mentorat
 Modalités de travail flexibles à distance, hybride et au bureau, là où proposées
 3 semaines de congés payés
 Ensemble d’avantages incluant des assurances médicale, dentaire et visuelle
 Congés de maladie

 GameSim est un employeur offrant l’égalité des chances. Nous sommes heureux de recevoir des candidatures de tous les milieux et toutes les identités, et nous les évaluons en fonction de leurs compétences, de leur expérience et de leur compatibilité avec le rôle offert.
 Keywords Studios s’engage à respecter une politique d’égalité des chances bien établie. Nous nous efforçons de créer un milieu de travail qui offre des chances égales à chaque employé(e) et candidat(e) potentiel(le).
 POLITIQUE DE PROTECTION DES DONNÉES PERSONNELLES

Level: P3 | QA Engineer III (Senior)
Location: Remote | Canada
Reports To: Tyler Chandler de Faye | Associate Manager, Operations & Efficiency https://www.linkedin.com/in/tyler-chandler-de-faye/
Type: Permanent | Full-Time

ABOUT SOLINK

Trusted by over 36,000 locations across 60+ countries - including brands like McDonald’s and JYSK - Solink delivers clarity when it counts. Our solutions help businesses reduce shrink, optimize performance, and respond proactively to potential threats.

THE ROLE

As a QA Engineer III (Internal Systems), you’ll play a hands-on role in solving meaningful problems, driving outcomes, and contributing directly to Solink’s growth. You'll collaborate across teams and be trusted to take ownership - because we believe great ideas come from everywhere.

You’ll own quality for Solink’s internal tools, starting with our Salesforce platform and the systems connected to it and growing to the other tools and automations our teams rely on: you’ll set the test strategy, build the test automation, and decide when a release is ready.

This is an opportunity for someone who’s energized by challenge, fast learning, and making a real impact.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own test strategy for Salesforce and, over time, our other internal tools: coverage goals, the mix of test types, our regression approach, and which tests to automate now, automate once a feature is stable, or keep manual by design.

 - Choose and build our test automation framework, starting with Salesforce and designed to extend to other internal tools, including tooling, test data model and reporting, and add automated quality gates to our deploy pipeline.

 - Build and maintain an automated regression suite for our highest-risk processes (quote configurator, Opportunity close to Work Order, Work Order lines to billing, and access by persona), and add a test whenever a bug reaches production or a process changes.

 - Design and run test cases for Salesforce changes (flows, validation rules, Apex, Lightning pages, permissions and the quote configurator), each with a persona, test data, steps and an expected result, covering edge cases, negative paths and boundary conditions, prioritized by risk.

 - Test as the real user, not as an admin, and run regression checks before anything reaches production so we know what a change should do and what it must not touch.

 - Check every change for downstream impact on connected systems (NetSuite, Solink Manage/CallHome, Ironclad, HubSpot): know which fields each integration reads and writes, test as the integration user, and confirm the first sync after release.

 - Extend test coverage beyond Salesforce to our other internal tools and automations, such as n8n workflows, Google Apps Script tools, Slack integrations and AI agents, as they take on business-critical work.

 - Run regression testing for Salesforce's three seasonal releases (Spring, Summer, Winter): review the release notes and upcoming release updates for anything that affects the org, run the regression suite in a preview sandbox before the Prod upgrade, and log issues in SPI ahead of the upgrade date.

 - Make the release-readiness call for production deploys based on test evidence and customer impact, and lead defect triage when a high-risk release goes wrong.

 - Support SPI (Salesforce Platform & Integrations) intake: review new issues, check each against the live org (permissions first, then regression or other causes), group issues with the same root cause, and co-author acceptance criteria so issues are ready for development with reproduction steps and the right approver tagged.

 - Own bug handling: reproduce, document and route bugs in SPI, retest fixes, record the result on the ticket, and close the test gap behind repeat failures.

 - Plan and run UAT with business testers: seed their test records, record Pass, Fail or Blocked with evidence, and turn feedback into clear findings.

 - Raise the bar for the developers who ship changes to Salesforce and our internal tools: review their Apex tests and acceptance criteria, and help build quality in from design rather than after implementation.

 - Use AI tools to speed up test design, test data setup and investigation, and verify AI-generated tests and diagnoses rather than taking them at face value.

WHAT YOU BRING

Must-Have:

 - 5+ years in QA, including designing and building a test automation framework, not only adding tests to an existing one.

 - Deep expertise in at least one automation language or framework, and experience testing across UI, API and integration layers.

 - Experience running automated tests as quality gates in a CI/CD pipeline.

 - Hands-on Salesforce experience (objects, fields, record pages, flows, validation rules, profiles and permission sets) and the ability to tell a permission problem from a logic problem.

 - Comfortable picking up a new internal tool quickly and working out how to test it, including tools with no existing tests or documentation.

 - Strong investigation habits and clear writing: you reproduce first, verify root causes yourself, document what you see, and can explain a failure to a salesperson, an ops lead and a developer.

 - Working knowledge of Jira: writing tickets, linking related issues, keeping statuses and comments accurate.

Nice-to-Have:

 - Salesforce test automation tools such as Provar, Copado Robotic Testing, or Playwright or Selenium against Lightning.

 - Experience with Apex test classes, Flow tests, SOQL or the Salesforce CLI.

 - Experience testing integrations between Salesforce and ERP, marketing or contract systems, or testing REST APIs directly.

 - Experience testing workflow automation or low-code tools such as n8n, Zapier or Google Apps Script, or testing AI-driven automations.

 - Experience running UAT with non-technical testers.

 - Salesforce Administrator certification, or willingness to earn it in your first year.

CAREER ARCHETYPE ROLE EXPECTATIONS

Career archetypes represent the foundational behaviours and performance standards expected of every employee, regardless of role or level.

At Solink, career archetypes define the baseline for how we show up and create impact. They are not aspirational traits or optional strengths, they are the minimum standards required to operate successfully within our environment. These expectations ensure consistency in how we think, collaborate, execute, and raise the performance bar. If someone consistently does not meet these standards, they are not aligned with what it takes to thrive at Solink.

This is a P3 level role. At Solink, individuals at this level are drivers who own initiatives end-to-end with very little direction, propose and launch initiatives, and clearly articulate the root cause of a problem along with a thought-through solution.

 - Own quality for Salesforce and our other internal tools end-to-end, escalating early when something is unclear or risky.

 - Make quality gate decisions from test evidence and customer impact, not schedule pressure, and say plainly what was and was not tested.

 - Handle access and data with care: use sandboxes, never touch production data without sign-off, and clean up after testing.

 - Keep every ticket self-contained so someone who was not there can follow what happened and why.

 - Raise the bar for the team by turning repeat defects into automated tests, clearer "ready for development" standards and better guardrails.

 - Treat the regression suite as a living asset: every escaped bug becomes a test case, and nothing reaches production without the relevant tests being run.

 - Share testing practice with developers and business testers through reviews, pairing and informal mentoring.
   
   

SECURITY REQUIREMENTS

 - Candidates must undergo a criminal records check upon hire;

 - Be a Canadian Citizen (dual citizens included), or eligible to work in Canada;

   
   

COMPENSATION

The salary range for this role is $86,203 - $102,366 CAD. We determine compensation based on the experience, skills, and impact you bring to the role. For this position, we are hiring within the P3 range. Candidates in this range will demonstrate end-to-end ownership of quality, hands-on experience building test automation, clear root-cause analysis, and the judgment to make release decisions from test evidence.

OUR VALUES

We do things the Solink way:

WHY SOLINK?

 - Comprehensive benefits: Fully paid health & dental (no waiting period) + $500 health spending account.

   
   

WHAT TO EXPECT FROM THE HIRING PROCESS

 1. Intro call with our Talent Team

 2. Interview with the Hiring Manager

 3. Role-relevant task or case (if applicable)

 4. Final interviews with cross-functional team members

 As Manager, SOX PMO - Business Process, you'll lead Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance for assigned business processes as part of GitLab's second line. This is advisory work, not repeatable testing: you'll deeply understand how processes work, evaluate risks as the business changes, and help control owners design and remediate controls that hold up to audit. Judgment matters more than procedure. You'll form well-supported conclusions, align with control owners and Internal Audit, and defend positions to external auditors. GitLab already uses AI extensively, and the next phase brings AI agents into our SOX processes. You'll help teams adopt them with confidence, finding creative ways to enable new ways of working while maintaining compliance. You'll also partner with the information technology (IT) SOX PMO on readiness for new systems and applications. This role reports to the Senior Director, SOX PMO, within the Chief Accounting Officer's organization.
 What You’ll Do 
 Lead SOX compliance for assigned business processes as the second-line subject matter expert, advising control owners who own and operate the controls. Deeply understand each process, its systems and data flows, and resolve open questions and assumptions early.
 Monitor risks from new and changing processes, products, and systems. Help control owners design, strengthen, or right-size controls, and contribute to the annual SOX risk assessment and scoping.
 Evaluate control deficiencies individually and in aggregate, identify root causes, and prepare well-supported severity assessments. Work with management to develop, implement, and monitor remediation plans.

 Partner with the IT SOX PMO to assess new systems and controls, including application controls and key reports.

 What You’ll Bring 
 Hands-on SOX and internal controls experience in control design, remediation, and deficiency evaluation, beyond testing alone. Experience in the software or technology industry is required; SOX PMO, Big Four risk advisory, or assurance experience is a strong plus.

 A strong understanding of SOX requirements and internal control frameworks, such as the Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of the Treadway Commission (COSO) framework.
 Professional judgment and skepticism: verifying facts against source documents, testing the reasonableness of data and conclusions, and recognizing missing information.

The Community You Will Join: 
 We are seeking a dedicated and enthusiastic candidate to provide exceptional Customer Service support to the Airbnb community as a Senior Support Specialist, Premium Support . The ideal candidate is flexible, hospitable, analytical, and committed to delivering the highest standards of service in English, spoken and written. 
 The Difference You Will Make: 
 The Senior Support Specialist, Premium Support functions on the front line interacting directly with both customers & internal stakeholders. As a Senior Support Specialist, Premium Support , you will be primarily responsible for providing end-to-end support to key members of our community experiencing an issue with their reservation, including but not limited to the Luxury segment. You will take ownership of cases, ensuring complete resolution while fostering strong relationships with our users along the way.
 A Senior Support Specialist, Premium Support needs strong communication skills, problem-solving abilities, and customer service expertise. They will be expected to work in strong autonomy, being able to assess a case & constantly looking for the right solution for both Host, Users and internal stakeholders. As part of this role, you are required to be flexible and may be required to move to different teams within Community Support and/or take up different responsibilities from those set out below. The ideal candidate will be open to a role which will evolve based on business needs and will be flexible to meet those needs. 
 A Typical Day: 
 The responsibilities listed below are not exhaustive. Given the fast-moving nature of this work, the responsibilities set out below may change and additional duties may be assigned as needed. 
 Complex case management: Provide the highest level of service to our community in each and every case, including handling the service’s most severe and urgent cases 
 Interact with Airbnb customers and community members through all current and future channels, both inside and outside of Airbnb tools
 Take end-to-end ownership of all assigned cases: ensuring a complete final resolution is reached based on workflows, management guidelines & your own assessment of the case situation
 Become a subject matter expert in Airbnb policies and procedures
 Explains and simplify complex information, provide appropriate context, and address complex questions with confidence
 Ability to negotiate & mediate between Host & Guest in resolving the issues at hand on high-stake & high-value reservations
 Proactively anticipate users expectations regarding case resolution and work towards the best outcome for all parties involved, thinking outside the box & constantly looking for compromises
 Manage highly sensitive cases end to end that might include working cross functionally with Legal, Policy, other services, etc. 
 Operate in full autonomy, making the decisions to follow or go outside of workflows to resolve our customers issues with the best outcome possible from both our community & business expectations
 Combining efficiency with bespoke quality: Set the gold standard for performance for the service, providing consistently personalized and exceptional customer support to guests and Hosts, ensuring their unique needs and preferences are met with the highest level of care and attention 
 Acts consistently impeccably in handling of customer-facing casework, personalizing communications and demonstrating the highest hospitality standards
 Drive cases to conclusion with a sense of urgency and without error, using strong judgment to make exceptions in ambiguous situations
 Participating in your team’s improvement: Leverage your functional operational knowledge to proactively lead the team to succeed 
 Provide insights about community experience and continuous improvement opportunities to your Management
 Supports the simplification of complex processes and ways of working within the team
 Supports Management on initiatives as assigned, such as to drive performance improvements, supporting management on consultations, acting as an SME, etc.
 Supports onboarding of new employees
 Be a positive force in the team and help management drive & land changes with the least frictions possible
 Willing to take on various tasks and responsibilities as needed (including moving teams) and showing openness to new challenges and a proactive approach to work
 Stakeholder engagement: You build and maintain strategic partnerships to achieve team or functional goals 
 Demonstrates a high degree of flexibility, approachability, and integrity when resolving sensitive/complex issues relying on management when in doubt
 Write clearly and concisely, translating complex ideas to multiple audiences, and knowing which stakeholder needs to be consulted about what 
 Build & nurture relationships outside of your team
 You are on-call to handle emergency situations in the evenings & weekends
 Inspire a culture where quality is a core principle.
 Your Expertise: 
 6+ years of relevant experience in multicultural customer service teams, preferably in the hospitality industry (experience with high-profile and influential clientele is preferred) and in a role making calls and handling customer/client contacts
 Hospitality experience is a plus, in particular working for technology platforms. Prior experience using phone, messaging, or live chat to interact with users/customers is preferred. 
 Experience engaging with executive-level stakeholders to resolve conflicts in a detailed, effective and timely manner, and demonstrated ability to explain complex ideas simply and clearly.
 Ability to work weekend days and public holidays, as well as early morning / evening shifts. Your schedule can change to meet business needs
 Your skills & expertise
 World class interpersonal and communication skills, both written and spoken, including conflict resolution.
 Active listening skills
 Empathy and patience in dealing with customers, especially in high-pressure situations
 Excellent organizational skills, including prioritization, multitasking, attention to detail, and meeting goals and commitments
 Passion for delivering exceptional customer service and setting a high bar
 Ability to thrive in an ambiguous, fast-paced, and complex environment, acting proactively to respond quickly and decisively
 Ability to adapt to new tasks and responsibilities as needed. 
 Proactive attitude towards embracing new challenges and adjusting to changing priorities and environments. 
 Capable of adjusting to evolving roles and job duties with openness and flexibility, as well as moving to a new team.
 Experience engaging with executive-level stakeholders, and demonstrated ability to explain complex ideas simply and clearly
 Able to assess risk accurately, understand level of urgency, exercise good judgment, and share the most pertinent information with stakeholders, including Executives
 Advanced computer skills, including Apple/Mac OS, Google Suite, and familiarity with CRM systems and the ability to quickly learn new tools
 Fluency in English, spoken and written is required.

This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with your recruiter on what provinces you are eligible to work from.

 This role is newly created and does not replace or backfill an existing position.

Job ID #32139: Volunteer Probationary Firefighter - 2027 Recruitment 
 Union: CLAC Local 911 
 Job Description ID #: 5319 
 Vacancy type: This posting will be used to fill current vacancies, as well as any further vacancies  
 VOLUNTEER FIREFIGHTER 
 Do you have a desire to help keep your community Healthy and Safe?  The Hamilton Fire Department is looking for individuals who have and can demonstrate the personal values of trust, honesty, integrity, compassion and empathy and can perform as part of a team. The successful candidate will demonstrate an ability to perform a number of tasks including fire protection and rescue services, fire inspection and public education within established policies and guidelines. With our continued commitment to an inclusive workforce, one of the strengths of our Department is the diversity of our people. We encourage you to join the Hamilton Fire Department as a Volunteer Firefighter and experience one of the most rewarding, engaging, and exciting opportunities within your community. 
 GENERAL DUTIES 
 Performs fire ground operations under the direction of a Supervisor, search and rescue, protecting exposures, confining, controlling and extinguishing the fire, salvaging and overhauling the structure and its contents so that lives are protected, and property loss is minimized, and performs these activities in accordance with department policies and procedures. 
 Performs rescue operations through, a primary and secondary search, stabilizing the scene and the victims’ injuries, and providing a means of egress so that the victim is moved to an area of safety while preventing injury to the rescuer or additional injuries to the victim. 
 Protects people and minimizes property and environmental damage through identification and mitigation of potential hazardous material incidents. 
 Operates fire apparatus within the parameters of the Highway Traffic Act and the vehicle’s design so that the apparatus is used safely and efficiently. 
 Applies first aid to stabilize the patients’ condition and prepares the patients for transport to medical care facilities. Inspect fire apparatus and equipment to ensure a level of response readiness, so that equipment life is extended, safety is ensured, and equipment operates properly. 
 Participates in fire safety inspections, including checking for fire hazards, fire protection systems, fire detection systems, and access and serviceability of fire department connections, so that a general level of safety can be maintained within a community. 
 Performs station duties by answering telephones and taking messages, cleaning and maintaining the station so they remain clean and functional, receiving and conducting inventory of station supplies, and performs these activities in accordance with department policies and procedures. 
 Performs public relations activities including public assistance, making presentations, participating in special activities, performing demonstrations and projecting a professional image while engaging the community with the primary goal of educating the public in fire safety. 
 Operates mobile and portable radios, computers and other communications equipment so that required messages are transmitted or received in accordance with department policies and procedures. 
 Assists with the development of pre-fire plans by conducting a survey of the structure and property, preparing a sketch with measurements, determining the type and location of hazardous material, the locations of fire protection systems and utility shutoffs; the type and density of occupancy and planning attack and evacuation routes and fire suppression procedures so that all pertinent information is available to fire suppression personnel for determining initial response and incident command. 
 Performs assigned record keeping duties, so that all related records and required documents are completed, maintained and all relevant legislation is complied with, to ensure overall efficient operation of the organization. 
 Performs in accordance with the provisions of applicable Health and Safety legislation and all City of Hamilton corporate and departmental policies and procedures related to Occupational Health and Safety. 
 QUALIFICATIONS 
   Grade 12 or approved equivalent. 
   You must live within the volunteer response area that you are applying to. 
   Must be able to work in a highly structured work environment and follow rules, regulations and procedures of the Hamilton Fire Department. 
  M ust be able to meet performance levels as outlined in the collective agreement including emergency responses, weekly training session requirements and regularly scheduled station duties. 
 Must be able to respond to emergency response calls. Preference will be given to those able to accommodate varied shifts. 
 Must be capable of learning and performing the various methods and techniques used in extinguishing and preventing fires and in rescue techniques. 
 Ability to conduct routine cleaning of all types of apparatus and equipment used. 
 Ability to communicate in English both orally and written. 
 Ability to make decisions and to react calmly and quickly in emergency situations. 
 Must possess and maintain the physical strength and agility to perform arduous duties and to competently operate all firefighting/rescue apparatus and equipment and all safety equipment under all types of adverse conditions frequently for prolonged periods of time. 
 Must have the ability to acquire a general knowledge of hazardous materials, poisonous substances, arson detection, life safety systems and other job-related subjects and be familiar with the procedures associated with these functions. 
 Must possess the ability to perform within confined spaces or high places. 
 Must successfully complete a Hamilton Fire Department written assessment and physical agility testing conducted by the Department during the recruitment process. 
 Must possess a valid Ontario Class “G” Driver’s Licence or equivalent with zero demerit points and satisfactory to the City of Hamilton at time of application and must be maintained throughout the entire process. Must be able to obtain an Ontario Class “DZ” Licence prior to completion of probationary period. 
 Must successfully complete the recruit training program which consists of in class training within the prescribed requirements of the collective agreement. 
 THIS POSITION REQUIRES A VALID CLASS “G” DRIVER’S LICENCE AND PROOF THEREOF IS REQUIRED AFTER HIRE. 
 NOTE 1: 
 If moving forward in the process, you will be contacted by the City of Hamilton with a scheduled medical assessment conducted by a third-party organization. Please note the following vision requirements: Have visual acuity, minimum requirement of 20/30 corrected OR 20/40 uncorrected both eyes tested together, normal depth perception and colour vision. 
 NOTE 2: 
 If moving forward in the process, you will be contacted by the City of Hamilton and will be required to obtain a Police Vulnerable Sector Check, at your own expense. You must have no criminal convictions for which a pardon has not been granted at time of application. 
 NOTE 3: 
 Photo ID is required at time of testing and throughout the process (one of the following): Driver’s Licence, Military ID, Passport, Health Card.

In 1933, Harry Beck introduced a radically different map of the London Underground. Rather than faithfully depicting the geography of London, he simplified the sprawling transit network into clean lines, clear connections, and a system that anyone could navigate. Distances were distorted, angles were standardized, and unnecessary details disappeared. The result was something far more useful than a geographically accurate map: a way for millions of people to understand a complex system and confidently find their way through it.
 Beck understood something fundamental. The best way to explain something complicated isn't to show people everything. It's to understand what matters to them and make that unmistakably clear.
 At Mercury, we believe great product marketing works the same way. Banking* and payments can be complex, but the value they create for customers shouldn't be. Our job is to understand what people need, find the essence of what we're building, and help customers see how it can make their lives better.

 S'installer au Canada, ce n'est pas juste changer de pays. C'est aussi choisir un endroit où on a envie de travailler tous les jours.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Forward Deployed Engineer embeds with Hopper's partners, some of the world's largest banks, airlines and travel companies, to bring our AI into their business end to end: getting the data, building and tuning the models, and taking them to production. You will lead data and modelling on site as part of a small forward-deployed team, acting as the bridge between partners and Research. What makes the role distinctive is that the data that matters lives inside partners' own systems, so you make it usable, securely, and turn each deployment into reusable tooling that makes the next partner faster.

 - Work on site with partner teams to connect to their systems, including on-premise and legacy platforms, and build secure, reliable data feeds.

 - Map messy, inconsistent commercial data from many sources into one clean model.

 - Build and run pipelines for large historical and near-real-time datasets, with monitoring and data quality checks.

 - Meet partners' security, privacy and IT review requirements, taking only the data the product needs.

 - Design, train and evaluate production ML models for a high-volume commercial use case, choosing the right approach and being clear about the trade-offs.

 - Build the evaluation and measurement that show whether the models are good enough, and where they aren't.

 - Build low-latency, high-throughput services that serve the models in production.

 - Design how the system decides what to answer and how, and how it improves from real usage.

 - Own reliability, cost and performance once the system is live.

 - Partner directly with technology and business teams, from first conversations to go-live.

 - Collaborate with Research and Product, feeding back what you learn in the field.

 - Turn each deployment into reusable tooling so the next partner goes faster.

AN IDEAL CANDIDATE HAS

 - 5+ years building and shipping production ML systems end to end, covering data, modelling, serving and monitoring, which you will apply to a high-volume commercial use case from day one.

 - Strong data engineering experience, having built and kept running pipelines over large, messy datasets, which you will use to turn partner data into one clean model.

 - Experience integrating with systems you don't control, such as enterprise, on-premise or legacy platforms, and working through a customer's security and IT review, so you can get partner data flowing securely.

 - Experience building and running services that handle thousands of requests per second at sub-second response times, which you will use to serve models in production.

 - Travel industry experience (airlines, hotels, OTAs, metasearch or travel technology) working with availability, rates, schedules and inventory, and the systems behind them such as GDS, NDC and airline and hotel reservation systems, so you can read partner data quickly and spot what matters.

 - Sound judgment on modelling trade-offs and the ability to explain them to non-technical partners, which you will use to guide partner teams through decisions from first conversations to go-live.

 - At least two deployments embedded with an enterprise customer, working inside their systems, data controls and security reviews, so you are ready to lead data and modelling on site.

 - Willingness to travel and spend multi-week stretches on site with partner teams.

 - Bonus: experience in both airline and hotel data, or in another high-volume marketplace (e-commerce, ad tech, fintech) as well as travel, to bring patterns from other verticals to each deployment.

 - Bonus: forecasting, estimation or recommendation models in production, and experience working alongside a research team to turn their methods into results at a customer.

 - Bonus: forward-deployed, solutions or integration engineering experience at an enterprise software or data company, or an advanced degree in computer science, statistics or a related field.

Perks and benefits of working with us

 - Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and upsides of pre-IPO equity packages

 - Unlimited PTO

 - Carrot Cash travel stipend

 - Open communication with management and company leadership

 - Small, dynamic teams = massive impact

Votre expertise. Votre influence. Notre performance collective. 
 Vous avez une solide expérience en contrôle des coûts et souhaitez jouer un rôle qui dépasse le suivi financier traditionnel? Vous aimez analyser, anticiper, conseiller et contribuer aux décisions qui façonnent la réussite des projets? Norda Stelo vous offre l'occasion de mettre votre expertise au service de l'ensemble de son portefeuille de projets, d'influencer les décisions stratégiques et de faire évoluer les pratiques de gestion financière à l'échelle de l'organisation. 
 L'équipe derrière le génie 
 Chez Norda Stelo, nous croyons que les grands projets méritent une vision à la hauteur de leurs ambitions. Notre Bureau de gestion de projet accompagne les organisations dans la réalisation de projets de toutes envergures, de la planification stratégique jusqu'à leur livraison. Présent dans des secteurs aussi variés que les mines, l'énergie, les infrastructures et l'industrie, il joue un rôle transversal auprès de l'ensemble de l'organisation. 
 Le Bureau de gestion de projet contribue à la réussite des ventes et des projets de Norda Stelo, de la préparation de l'offre de service à la réalisation des mandats. Nous travaillons avec les équipes de vente, les responsables de projet et les centres d'excellence pour que nos experts se concentrent sur ce qu'ils font de mieux. 
 Notre raison d'être 
 Soutenir la réussite des ventes et des projets de Norda Stelo : contribuer à des offres de service solides et compétitives, puis à une réalisation rigoureuse et performante des mandats. Nous faisons évoluer nos pratiques pour mieux saisir les occasions d’affaires et anticiper les risques. 
 Ce qui nous définit 
 · Le soutien aux ventes. Avec les équipes de vente et les experts, nous valorisons nos expertises et nos réalisations dans les offres de service. Nos propositions répondent aux besoins des clients et se démarquent par leur qualité. 
 · Le soutien aux projets. Nous appuyons les responsables de projet avec le contrôle des coûts, les agents de projet, le contrôle documentaire, la formation et le suivi des risques. 
 · La transformation opérationnelle. Nous faisons évoluer nos processus, nos outils et nos mesures de performance, avec une gouvernance claire, pour améliorer en continu notre façon de gérer les projets. 
 Notre façon de travailler 
 Nous accompagnons chaque projet de bout en bout, de l'offre de service à la clôture. Nous croyons à l'intelligence collective et à la collaboration, avec les valeurs de Norda Stelo : confiance, excellence, intégrité, respect, innovation et adaptabilité. 
 Notre ambition 
 Être le partenaire privilégié de nos équipes de vente et de projet : des offres de service mieux préparées pour remporter des mandats rentables, et des projets mieux soutenus pour les livrer avec confiance. 
 Votre rôle : influencer, anticiper et faire évoluer 
 Relevant de la Directrice du Bureau de gestion de projet, vous serez responsable de la gouvernance financière et de la fiabilité des données de performance pour l'ensemble du portefeuille de projets. 
 Vous agirez comme une référence en contrôle des coûts et un partenaire stratégique auprès des directeurs et responsables de projets. Votre capacité à analyser les résultats, anticiper les risques et formuler des recommandations éclairées contribuera directement à la qualité des décisions et à la performance financière de l'organisation. 
 Au-delà du suivi financier, vous aurez l'occasion de structurer, d'harmoniser et de faire évoluer les pratiques de contrôle des coûts à l'échelle de Norda Stelo. 
 Votre influence ne se limitera pas aux chiffres : elle contribuera à façonner nos façons de gérer et de piloter les projets. 
 Vos principaux mandats et responsabilités 
 Assurer une vision globale de la performance financière : consolider, analyser et interpréter les données financières de l'ensemble du portefeuille afin d'offrir une lecture claire de la santé des projets. 
 Anticiper les risques et les écarts : identifier les tendances, les dépassements potentiels et les enjeux financiers, évaluer leurs impacts et proposer des stratégies d'intervention. 
 Piloter les prévisions financières : superviser les suivis budgétaires, analyser les coûts engagés et les coûts à terminaison, et produire des prévisions consolidées fiables. 
 Conseiller les équipes de direction : accompagner les directeurs et responsables de projets dans l'analyse de leur performance financière et les soutenir dans leurs prises de décision. 
 Optimiser le contrôle des coûts : recommander des mesures correctives, évaluer les impacts financiers des changements de portée et contribuer à la maîtrise des budgets. 
 Faire évoluer les pratiques : développer, harmoniser et améliorer les outils, méthodes et processus de contrôle des coûts à l'échelle de l'organisation. 
 Garantir la qualité de l'information : effectuer des vérifications ciblées afin d'assurer l'exactitude, la cohérence et la fiabilité des données financières et des prévisions. 
 Partager votre expertise : agir comme personne-ressource auprès des équipes, favoriser le transfert de connaissances et contribuer au développement d'une culture de gestion axée sur la rigueur et la performance. 
 Votre profil 
 Baccalauréat ou DEC en finance, comptabilité, administration, ingénierie ou dans un domaine pertinent. 
 10 ans et plus d'expérience en contrôle des coûts, en contrôle de projets ou en analyse financière dans un environnement de projets. 
 Expérience significative dans un environnement d'ingénierie, de construction, industriel ou multidisciplinaire (un atout). 
 Excellente maîtrise du suivi budgétaire, de l'analyse des écarts, des prévisions financières et des estimations à terminaison. 
 Maîtrise avancée d'Excel et aisance avec les systèmes et outils de gestion de projets. 
 Fortes capacités d'analyse, de synthèse et de vulgarisation de l'information financière. 
 Aptitude à influencer, conseiller et mobiliser des intervenants à différents niveaux de l'organisation. 
 Leadership, autonomie, rigueur et esprit d'amélioration continue. 
 Bilinguisme français et anglais, à l'oral comme à l'écrit. 
 La connaissance de la langue anglaise est demandée, car le poste nécessite de transiger avec des clients et collègues anglophones des États-Unis/Ouest canadien. 
 Pourquoi choisir Norda Stelo? 
 Parce qu'ici, votre expertise peut avoir un impact bien au-delà de votre rôle! 
 Une influence à l'échelle de l'organisation : une vision transversale du portefeuille et la possibilité de faire évoluer les pratiques de gestion. 
 Une proximité avec les décideurs : un accès direct à la direction et une contribution concrète aux orientations du Bureau. 
 Une diversité de projets : des mandats stimulants dans les secteurs des mines, de l'énergie, des infrastructures et de l'industrie. 
 Un environnement propice à votre développement : formations, mentorat, plan de développement personnalisé et remboursement des formations et certifications admissibles, notamment le PMP. 
 Une carrière à long terme : un poste permanent au sein d'une firme en croissance qui valorise l'initiative et l'expertise. 
 Une culture sérieusement humaine : un milieu où la collaboration, la transparence, l'autonomie et la reconnaissance font partie de notre quotidien. 
 Depuis plus de 60 ans, Norda Stelo met son expertise en ingénierie au service de projets qui font une différence. Présente dans plus de 50 pays, notre firme est certifiée B Corp et figure parmi les Sociétés les mieux gérées au Canada depuis 2022. 
 Prêt(e) à donner une nouvelle dimension à votre expertise et à influencer la performance de projets d'envergure? 
 Suivez votre étoile et joignez-vous à une équipe où votre expertise compte, vos idées font avancer les choses et votre contribution génère de l'ingénierie d'impact! 
 Vous ne répondez pas à tous les critères? Nous vous invitons tout de même à soumettre votre candidature. Nous sommes toujours intéressés à découvrir de nouveaux talents!

 We are looking to fill an opening for a Senior Product Manager to join Aviso’s Product Management team and help shape the future of investing for Canadians through a best-in-class wealth advisor platform.

 Set product direction and measurable outcomes for the product family with the Director of Product Management; align the areas owned by your Product Owners with customer needs and Aviso’s business priorities

About Tailscale 
 About the Role 
 We are seeking a Product Manager to own Tailscale's networking features — the layer that decides how traffic finds its destination by name on top of Tailscale’s seamless mesh connectivity solution. Concretely, you will own four feature sets: App Connectors , DNS , Funnel , and Tailscale Serve & Services .
 A tailnet gives every device an identity and an address. Networking features are what turn addresses into something a person, a script, or an AI agent can actually use — a name, a service, an app, a URL.
 App Connectors route traffic to specific SaaS and private applications by name, so access follows the app rather than the IP.
 DNS — MagicDNS, split DNS, custom name servers, search domains
 Tailscale Serve & Services make a workload — not a machine — the unit of connectivity and access: addressable, load-balanced, and durable across the instances behind it. This is the wedge that lets customers replace a service registry, and eventually much of what they use a service mesh for, with Tailscale.
 Funnel is Tailscale's ingress story: securely exposing a Service running inside the tailnet to the public internet, from a hobbyist sharing a dev server to production webhooks and public endpoints.
 This is the most user-visible role in Tailscale's Dataplane Platform, and the work is as much product design as it is networking. DNS settings, connector topologies, and service definitions are configured by network engineers and IT admins in the admin console, API, and CLI, and the distance between "magical" and "unusable" is the object model, the defaults, and the error messages. 
 See How Tailscale Works , Tailscale Funnel , and Four ways to Tailscale a service to learn more.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Tailscale's networking features: App Connectors, DNS, Funnel, and Tailscale Services
 Own the operator experience across these surfaces: how network engineers and IT admins configure, segment, monitor, and troubleshoot them at scale, in both the admin console and the CLI
 Partner with GTM, Customer Success, and Solutions Engineering on production commitments and strategic deals, and champion the migration path from reverse proxies, bastion hosts, cloud ingress, and service meshes to Tailscale
 Build systematic customer insight across the full spread of Tailscale users, from a homelab operator exposing a media server through Funnel to a large enterprise replacing its service registry
 What We Are Looking For 
 7+ years in product management, including direct ownership of an application-layer connectivity product: reverse proxies, ingress controllers or gateways, API gateways, service mesh or service registry, DNS and traffic management, secure tunneling and exposure products, or identity-aware proxy connectors

 End-to-end ownership of a product area: strategy, requirements, launch (docs, enablement, rollout), and the iteration after launch
 Evidence of data-informed decisions — metrics you defined, instrumentation you pushed for, and at least one time the data changed your mind

 Kubernetes networking: ingress, Gateway API, operators, or service exposure patterns
 Hands-on experience with secure tunneling and exposure products (ngrok, Cloudflare Tunnel, Cloudflare Access, Teleport, Zscaler Private Access) as a builder or a heavy user
 Abuse prevention, rate limiting, or trust and safety work on a publicly exposed service
